scope: Dependency and dataset input materials only; the final candidate and its qualification are separate.

changed_sources.name: rhai_codegen
changed_sources.source_revision_limit: Published VCS metadata marks the tree dirty. These are the upstream MIT and Apache-2.0 texts at the repository root at its recorded base revision (the crate is the codegen/ folder of that repository), consistent with the published MIT OR Apache-2.0 declaration; they do not establish an identical source tree.

changes: Cargo.lock differs from the 0.3.1 file (sha256 db3686948be29fddd9815d8bcd64c0943d4c2efede3cc9bcebca9f0e0e977809): its 532 third-party records become 472. 457 are byte-identical, 9 are added, 69 are removed, and 6 keep their version and checksum but list other dependencies.

Added: castaway 0.2.4, compact_str 0.10.0, const-random 0.1.18, const-random-macro 0.1.16, rhai 1.27.0, rhai_codegen 3.3.0, smartstring 1.0.1, thin-vec 0.2.21, tiny-keccak 2.0.2. They come with rhai (pinned =1.27.0), the scripting language of the experimental motion scenes (#99): an optional dependency enabled only by the motion feature, and a dev-dependency of the tests.

From 0.4.0 the release packages are built with the motion feature (cargo dev build --gui --mcp --motion, tools/delivery-build.ps1), so rhai is compiled in. cargo tree --locked --offline -e normal --features gui,mcp,motion, for x86_64-pc-windows-gnu and x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, gives three groups. Linked into the binaries: rhai, smartstring, thin-vec (through rhai) and const-random (through ahash, under eframe and egui, once rhai turns on ahash's compile-time-rng). Run only while compiling, never linked: rhai_codegen and const-random-macro (procedural macros) and tiny-keccak (a dependency of const-random-macro). Not reached: compact_str and castaway. All nine travel in the vendored source materials, which cover the whole locked graph.

Removed: the 69 records listed in removed_cargo_records, mostly the HTTP and TLS stack of the update prototype removed in #73 (reqwest, hyper, rustls, ring, quinn, the icu and zerovec families, zip). A removed record needs no reading: none of its texts is distributed any more.

Same version and checksum, so the same archive, with another dependency list: ahash 0.8.12 (+ const-random), getrandom 0.2.17 (- js-sys, wasm-bindgen), getrandom 0.4.3 (- js-sys, rand_core, wasm-bindgen), once_cell 1.21.4 (+ portable-atomic), semver 1.0.28 (- serde, serde_core), smallvec 1.16.5 (+ serde).
The noh package's own entry: version 0.3.1 to 0.4.0; base64 0.22.1, quick-xml, reqwest, ring, semver, windows-sys 0.61.2 and zip leave its dependencies, rhai joins them.

assets/rust-notices.lock.json gains one notice supplement, for rhai_codegen 3.3.0, published without a licence file. It pins https://github.com/rhaiscript/rhai at aaf90906bfa7eae090fc236b8572a67528cab3ed, the commit in the crate's .cargo_vcs_info.json (path_in_vcs codegen, marked dirty), and the repository root's LICENSE-APACHE.txt and LICENSE-MIT.txt by Git blob and SHA-256. They are the texts rhai 1.27.0 ships from the same commit, with LF line ends where the published rhai archive has CRLF (identical once CR is removed).
Every other hashed input is byte-identical to its 0.3.1 value.

licence_reading.method: By hand, for the nine added records: each notice file the generator selects was opened and compared with the declared licence. The notices were then generated from the whole vendored graph (cargo vendor --locked --offline as tools/delivery.py sources runs it, 472 crates): missing_notice_texts is empty; missing_original_notice_texts lists only dispatch-0.2.0, as before, covered by its declared-licence supplement.

readings.smartstring-1.0.1: MPL-2.0+ (the deprecated SPDX form of MPL-2.0 or later); LICENCE.md is the Mozilla Public License 2.0 and src/lib.rs carries the MPL 2.0 header. MPL 2.0 is a file-level licence: the source of covered files must be available to those who receive an executable form. The crate is linked into the release binaries (through rhai, with the motion feature). Its obligations are those already met for symphonia 0.5.5 and four symphonia-* crates (MPL-2.0), linked through rodio in every release: the complete unmodified source of each covered file travels in the release's -materials.zip (vendor/smartstring-1.0.1), and LICENCE.md is copied into RUST-NOTICES.txt, which every package carries under licenses/rust. NOH does not modify the crate.

readings.tiny-keccak-2.0.2: CC0-1.0; LICENSE is the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal text.
